tool_signatures.name: analyze_collection_schema
tool_signatures.description: Analyze collection schema with relationship mapping and validation

tool_signatures.name: analyze_relationships
tool_signatures.description: Analyze relationships across collections

tool_signatures.name: apply_schema
tool_signatures.description: Apply a schema diff produced by diff_schema. Changes the live data model and can drop collections and fields.

tool_signatures.name: bulk_operations
tool_signatures.description: Execute bulk create, update, and delete operations

tool_signatures.name: create_collection
tool_signatures.description: Create a new collection with optional fields. Creates a real table with an auto-increment

tool_signatures.name: create_field
tool_signatures.description: Create a new field in a collection

tool_signatures.name: create_flow
tool_signatures.description: Create a new automation flow

tool_signatures.name: create_item
tool_signatures.description: Create a new item in a collection

tool_signatures.name: create_relationship
tool_signatures.description: Create relationships between collections (O2O, O2M, M2O, M2M, M2A)

tool_signatures.name: delete_collection
tool_signatures.description: Delete a collection (requires confirmation)

tool_signatures.name: delete_field
tool_signatures.description: Delete a field from a collection (requires confirmation)

tool_signatures.name: delete_flow
tool_signatures.description: Delete a flow and all its operations (requires confirmation)

tool_signatures.name: delete_items
tool_signatures.description: Delete items from a collection, either by explicit IDs or by a query. Providing neither deletes nothing. Since Directus 12.4 a query resolves its targets under the token

tool_signatures.name: diagnose_collection_access
tool_signatures.description: Diagnose collection access issues and permissions

tool_signatures.name: diff_schema
tool_signatures.description: Compare a schema snapshot against the current data model and report what applying it would change. Read-only — nothing is modified.

tool_signatures.name: get_collection_items
tool_signatures.description: Get items from a collection with optional filtering and pagination

tool_signatures.name: get_collection_schema
tool_signatures.description: Get the schema for a specific collection

tool_signatures.name: get_files
tool_signatures.description: Get files with optional filtering and pagination

tool_signatures.name: get_flow
tool_signatures.description: Get a specific flow by ID with optional operations

tool_signatures.name: get_flows
tool_signatures.description: Get flows with optional filtering and pagination

tool_signatures.name: get_operations
tool_signatures.description: Get flow operations with optional filtering by flow

tool_signatures.name: get_schema_snapshot
tool_signatures.description: Read a snapshot of the data model (collections, fields, relations). Pass include_collections or exclude_collections for a partial snapshot.

tool_signatures.name: get_user
tool_signatures.description: Get a specific user by ID

tool_signatures.name: get_users
tool_signatures.description: Get all users with optional filtering and pagination

tool_signatures.name: import_data
tool_signatures.description: Import rows from a CSV or JSON file into one collection, or into several related collections at once using a flat multi-collection file. Subject to the Directus IMPORT_MAX_FILE_SIZE limit (50mb by default).\n\nSingle-collection: pass

tool_signatures.name: list_collections
tool_signatures.description: List all collections in the Directus instance. Folders (no table behind them) and inactive collections (Directus 12.4 refuses to read or write their contents) are marked.

tool_signatures.name: refresh_collection_cache
tool_signatures.description: Refresh Directus collection cache and verify access

tool_signatures.name: search_tools
tool_signatures.description: Find the tools on this server that match a task description, and return their full definitions so they can be called directly. Use this first when unsure which tool to use.

tool_signatures.name: trigger_flow
tool_signatures.description: Manually trigger a flow execution

tool_signatures.name: update_field
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing field in a collection

tool_signatures.name: update_flow
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing flow

tool_signatures.name: update_item
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing item in a collection. In versioned collections the published item is read-only — target a draft version instead.

tool_signatures.name: validate_collection_creation
tool_signatures.description: Validate that a newly created collection is properly accessible

tool_signatures.name: validate_collection_schema
tool_signatures.description: Validate collection schema and relationships
